items.name: Matanzas Warehouse
items.where: Southwest corner of the plantation near the crocodile icon; the key lies on a body behind the crocodile pond on a small corner island.
items.gate: Warehouse key (randomised after the first raid; 2-hour cooldown, repeatable)

items.name: Cat Island Warehouse
items.where: Looted for you during Sequence 03 Mission 05; afterwards the key is random, usually carried by an enemy.
items.reward: Painting: The Burning of the Royal James (automatic)

items.name: Black Island Warehouse
items.where: Overhear two NPCs near the warehouse, then find the soldier with the key at a campfire on the path to the southwest beach. Key may fail to spawn; page suggests finishing Lucy's 2nd officer quest and waiting 2 real hours, which commenters say did not work for everyone.
items.gate: Warehouse key (randomised after the first raid; 2-hour cooldown, repeatable)

items.name: Tortuga Warehouse
items.where: Loot a banana crate slightly west of the plantation centre.
items.gate: Warehouse key (randomised after the first raid; 2-hour cooldown, repeatable)

items.name: New Bone Warehouse
items.where: Defeat the enemy at the Mayan Stelae in the northwest corner of the island.
items.gate: Warehouse key (randomised after the first raid; 2-hour cooldown, repeatable)
items.reward: Painting: An English Ship in Action with Barbary Vessels

items.name: Havana Warehouse
items.where: Defeat the enemy in the northwest corner of the plantation.
items.gate: Warehouse key (randomised after the first raid; 2-hour cooldown, repeatable)

items.name: Nassau Warehouse
items.where: Defeat the enemy on the beach southwest of the warehouse area; two guards at the warehouse hint he has the key.
items.gate: Warehouse key (randomised after the first raid; 2-hour cooldown, repeatable)

items.name: Kingston South Warehouse
items.where: Defeat the enemy directly north of the big barn.
items.gate: Warehouse key (randomised after the first raid; 2-hour cooldown, repeatable)

items.name: Kingston North Warehouse
items.where: Defeat the patrolling enemy around the manor in the northeast of the warehouse area.
items.gate: Warehouse key (randomised after the first raid; 2-hour cooldown, repeatable)

notes: Each warehouse gives a painting needed for the Dilettante trophy.
